title: Prepositions
description: Test your knowledge of common English prepositions

questions.question: I usually go to work ___ bus.
questions.explanation: We use 'by' to indicate the method of transportation (by bus, by train, by car).

questions.question: She's been living in London ___ 2018.
questions.explanation: 'Since' is used with a specific point in time when something began.

questions.question: The book is ___ the table.
questions.explanation: 'On' is used when something is in contact with a surface.

questions.question: I'll meet you ___ the cinema at 8 PM.
questions.explanation: 'At' is used for specific points (at the cinema, at the corner).

questions.question: She walked ___ the street to the shop.
questions.explanation: 'Down' indicates movement along a street from one end toward another.

questions.question: The cat is hiding ___ the sofa.
questions.explanation: 'Under' is commonly used to indicate something is directly below something else.

questions.question: We're flying ___ the Atlantic Ocean tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 'Over' is used when talking about movement across something by flying.

questions.question: I'll be back ___ an hour.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used with periods of time to indicate when something will happen in the future.

questions.question: The picture is hanging ___ the wall.
questions.explanation: 'On' is used when something is attached to a vertical surface.

questions.question: She stood ___ the crowd to see better.
questions.explanation: 'Between' is used when something is in the middle of two distinct things or people.
